english_translations.shakir: I swear by the early hours of the day,

ayahs.translation_bn: রাতের শপথ যখন তা হয় শান্ত-নিঝুম,
ayahs.translation_en: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
ayahs.conventional_en: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root س-ج-و (s-j-w): quietness, serene homeostatic stillness of the nocturnal biosphere.

ayahs.translation_bn: তোমার প্রতিপালক তোমাকে কক্ষনো পরিত্যাগ করেননি, আর তিনি অসন্তুষ্টও নন।
ayahs.translation_en: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
ayahs.conventional_en: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root و-د-ع (w-d-'): abandonment; ق-ل-ي (q-l-y): aversion; complete affirmation of uninterrupted divine care.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তোমার প্রতিপালক তোমাকে কক্ষনো পরিত্যাগ করেননি, আর তিনি অসন্তুষ্টও নন।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root و-د-ع (w-d-'): abandonment; ق-ل-ي (q-l-y): aversion; complete affirmation of uninterrupted divine care.

english_translations.sahih_international: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
english_translations.pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.
english_translations.shakir: Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor has He become displeased,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), your Lord has not abandoned you (by not sending you His revelation), nor is He displeased with you.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Your Lord (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) has neither forsaken you nor hated you.
english_translations.arberry: Thy Lord has neither forsaken thee nor hates thee

ayahs.translation_bn: অবশ্যই পরবর্তী সময় পূর্ববর্তী সময়ের চেয়ে তোমার জন্য হবে অধিক উৎকৃষ্ট।
ayahs.translation_en: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
ayahs.conventional_en: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root أ-خ-ر ('-kh-r): ultimate culmination; continuous upward evolutionary trajectory of divine guidance.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অবশ্যই পরবর্তী সময় পূর্ববর্তী সময়ের চেয়ে তোমার জন্য হবে অধিক উৎকৃষ্ট।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root أ-خ-ر ('-kh-r): ultimate culmination; continuous upward evolutionary trajectory of divine guidance.

english_translations.sahih_international: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
english_translations.pickthall: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.
english_translations.shakir: And surely what comes after is better for you than that which has gone before.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The reward in the next life will certainly be better for you than worldly gains.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And indeed the Hereafter is better for you than the present (life of this world).
english_translations.arberry: and the Last shall be better for thee than the First.

ayahs.translation_bn: শীঘ্রই তোমার প্রতিপালক তোমাকে (এত নি‘মাত) দিবেন যার ফলে তুমি সন্তুষ্ট হয়ে যাবে।
ayahs.translation_en: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
ayahs.conventional_en: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ع-ط-و ('-ṭ-w): continuous generous endowment; ر-ض-و (r-ḍ-w): complete existential fulfillment.
ayahs.conventional_bn: শীঘ্রই তোমার প্রতিপালক তোমাকে (এত নি‘মাত) দিবেন যার ফলে তুমি সন্তুষ্ট হয়ে যাবে।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ع-ط-و ('-ṭ-w): continuous generous endowment; ر-ض-و (r-ḍ-w): complete existential fulfillment.

english_translations.sahih_international: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
english_translations.pickthall: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.
english_translations.shakir: And soon will your Lord give you so that you shall be well pleased.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord will soon grant you sufficient favors to please you.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And verily, your Lord will give you (all i.e. good) so that you shall be well-pleased.
english_translations.arberry: Thy Lord shall give thee, and thou shalt be satisfied.

ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি কি তোমাকে ইয়াতীম অবস্থায় পান নাই? অতঃপর তিনি আশ্রয় দিয়েছেন।
ayahs.translation_en: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
ayahs.conventional_en: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root أ-و-ي ('-w-y): providing protective shelter and biological refuge.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তিনি কি তোমাকে ইয়াতীম অবস্থায় পান নাই? অতঃপর তিনি আশ্রয় দিয়েছেন।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root أ-و-ي ('-w-y): providing protective shelter and biological refuge.

english_translations.sahih_international: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
english_translations.pickthall: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?
english_translations.shakir: Did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Did He not find you as an orphan and give you shelter?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Did He not find you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) an orphan and gave you a refuge?
english_translations.arberry: Did He not find thee an orphan, and shelter thee?

ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি তোমাকে পেয়েছিলেন পথের দিশা-হীন, অতঃপর দেখালেন সঠিক পথ।
ayahs.translation_en: And He found you lost and guided [you],
ayahs.conventional_en: And He found you lost and guided [you],
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ض-ل-ل (ḍ-l-l): wandering in earnest search of ultimate truth prior to revelation; ه-د-ي (h-d-y): divine guidance.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তিনি তোমাকে পেয়েছিলেন পথের দিশা-হীন, অতঃপর দেখালেন সঠিক পথ।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ض-ل-ل (ḍ-l-l): wandering in earnest search of ultimate truth prior to revelation; ه-د-ي (h-d-y): divine guidance.

english_translations.sahih_international: And He found you lost and guided [you],
english_translations.pickthall: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.
english_translations.shakir: And find you lost (that is, unrecognized by men) and guide (them to you)?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Did He not find you wandering about and give you guidance?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And He found you unaware (of the Quran, its legal laws, and Prophethood, etc.) and guided you?
english_translations.arberry: Did He not find thee erring, and guide thee?

ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি তোমাকে পেলেন নিঃস্ব, অতঃপর করলেন অভাবমুক্ত।
ayahs.translation_en: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
ayahs.conventional_en: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ع-ي-ل ('-y-l): material poverty; غ-ن-ي (gh-n-y): sufficiency, wealth of heart and resources.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তিনি তোমাকে পেলেন নিঃস্ব, অতঃপর করলেন অভাবমুক্ত।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ع-ي-ل ('-y-l): material poverty; غ-ن-ي (gh-n-y): sufficiency, wealth of heart and resources.

english_translations.sahih_international: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
english_translations.pickthall: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.
english_translations.shakir: And find you in want and make you to be free from want?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: And did He not find you in need and make you rich?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And He found you poor, and made you rich (selfsufficient with selfcontentment, etc.)?
english_translations.arberry: Did He not find thee needy, and suffice thee?

ayahs.translation_bn: কাজেই তুমি ইয়াতীমের প্রতি কঠোরতা করবে না।
ayahs.translation_en: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
ayahs.conventional_en: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ق-ه-ر (q-h-r): coercive domination, exploitation of the weak.
ayahs.conventional_bn: কাজেই তুমি ইয়াতীমের প্রতি কঠোরতা করবে না।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ق-ه-ر (q-h-r): coercive domination, exploitation of the weak.

english_translations.sahih_international: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,
english_translations.shakir: Therefore, as for the orphan, do not oppress (him).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Therefore, treat not the orphan with oppression,
english_translations.arberry: As for the orphan, do not oppress him,

ayahs.translation_en: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
ayahs.conventional_en: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ن-ه-ر (n-h-r): harsh verbal repulse; universal duty to honor legitimate seekers.

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ن-ه-ر (n-h-r): harsh verbal repulse; universal duty to honor legitimate seekers.

english_translations.sahih_international: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
english_translations.pickthall: Therefor the beggar drive not away,
english_translations.shakir: And as for him who asks, do not chide (him),
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and do not reject the beggars
english_translations.arberry: and as for the beggar, scold him not;

ayahs.translation_bn: আর তুমি তোমার রব-এর নি‘মাতকে (তোমার কথা, কাজকর্ম ও আচরণের মাধ্যমে) প্রকাশ করতে থাক।
ayahs.translation_en: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
ayahs.conventional_en: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ح-د-ث (ḥ-d-th): openly sharing and transmitting divine benevolence.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তুমি তোমার রব-এর নি‘মাতকে (তোমার কথা, কাজকর্ম ও আচরণের মাধ্যমে) প্রকাশ করতে থাক।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ح-د-ث (ḥ-d-th): openly sharing and transmitting divine benevolence.

english_translations.sahih_international: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
english_translations.pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!
english_translations.shakir: And as for the favor of your Lord, do announce (it).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and proclaim the bounties of your Lord.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And proclaim the Grace of your Lord (i.e. the Prophethood and all other Graces).
english_translations.arberry: and as for thy Lord's blessing, declare it.
